description: The cert-manager integration now supports provider-neutral ACME External Account Binding (EAB) via `WithExternalAccountBinding`, enabling certificate authorities that require it (such as ZeroSSL and Google Trust Services) in addition to Let's Encrypt. `WithLetsEncryptProduction`/`WithLetsEncryptStaging` and the mixed literal/parameter `WithAcmeServer` overload were removed in favor of an explicit ACME directory URL with `WithAcmeServer`.
name: ACME External Account Binding support for cert-manager
